scope: Standalone std::mem::size_of/align_of probe; no product calls, benchmarks, or Cargo build. Data/FileData/DirectoryData/Node definitions were extracted verbatim from cow_tree.rs except replacing the PieceTree type path. Source-backed wrapper types use their actual32-byte identity representation. Arc<()> substitutes the same pointer representation of Arc<PieceNode>. The after model adds the actual contiguous_spool_len u64 field.
output:
before PieceTree size=16 align=8
before FileData size=104 align=8
before Data size=104 align=8
before Node size=192 align=8
after PieceTree size=24 align=8
after FileData size=112 align=8
after Data size=112 align=8
after Node size=200 align=8
result_limit: This directly observes the standalone Rust model layout on the current host. It is not instrumentation of a historical or candidate product binary and does not measure performance.
